title: 52-bit-VA flipped-grid stored-leaf birthday search on secp256k1 at 124.442841076498146: soispoke 17a007c8 plus one ST64B fraction line per component

claims.statement: For uniform production secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the classical cold grouped stored-leaf birthday search of proof.md on a 52-bit-VA generator/relay/home machine recovers x with probability at least 0.390000001 over the challenge and fresh algorithm coins (Chen-Stein on cross-generator leaf pairs with per-chain random start and step; drops, caps, wrong class indices, label errors, the carry sites of section 3.4 and the fixup meter's cap are charged failure rows; success.md). Its expected total work is at most 2^124.442841076498146 target-group-operation equivalents (1000 scalar AArch64 instructions per unit; at most 209.0363 per leaf), E-averaged over 160 Y-chain groups that stop at the first resolving group, with every walk, joint K3 hit, exact-carry key path and defect row charged by history-conditional domination (success.md 6.6); the worst case on every run, 2^176.807579 instructions, is disclosed. Each of 2^68 generators holds 256 permanent X's with unified 8x32-bit slot-interleaved tables in TTBR0 [2^48, 2^51) and 43-bit beta tables in TTBR1 [2^64-2^51, 2^64), streaming 2^17-element Y-chains across X-pair partial-fraction inverses (C1b, fwd 78.38), split u/v (C2), LD64B lookups (C4a) and one ST64B per fraction line into the pair entries (Normal Non-cacheable; bwd 1138.75) and 5-instruction emits (keys 132.5); 2^42 relays and 2^83 homes (47-bit hash buckets, 256-byte DC ZVA BS=6) synchronize via store-release messages, DMB ISH, 128-bit/STADDL received counters and two-wave link barriers (sections 2, 4). Peak memory at most 2^135.2301 bytes; preprocessing at most 2^116.0470 units, included; no advice; every kernel instruction has an A64 encoding (LLVM assembles all three kernels, and its disassembly has the same instruction counts a64.py runs); certificate.py checks every declared figure. This package is soispoke 17a007c8 (declared; judged valid at 124.448751886343643) plus that fraction-line change (proof.md section 0, 3.1). 17a007c8 built on soispoke ae21db39 and 45552a5c, kaankolcu 38df975c, 8c3852be, 2af6aeef, e8c1f92c, f0d01922, aburan28 c3e0530e, 7516608f, 9a4da1ce, eb58c3c4, pepedesigner 22e3cf05 and our 3ff1b1a5 and 7f4f73d0 (declared dependencies; proof.md 9; kaankolcu d6de3906 credited, not declared, as it was never published); no prior acceptance or score is a premise. An analytic bound, not a practical break.

experiments.purpose: Verifies yround Y-chain generation, C1b/C2/C4a/8x32b leaf kernels against bit-exact models and affine curve addition, 3.4 error/fixup sites and unified tbld (sites.py), 52-bit-VA 4x4x16 generator/relay/home machine with two-wave completion and LS64/VA52/encoding-form mutant rejections (machine.py), and every kernel count against certificate.py.
